title: Tigo Finds His Voice
moral: Trying despite fear helps you grow confident.

scenes.summary: Tigo is a shy tiger who prefers watching others instead of performing.
scenes.text:
Tigo the Tiger Who Was Too Shy

In a deep green jungle, lived a little tiger named Tigo.

Tigo had bright stripes, big eyes, and a gentle heart.

He loved to watch others play and perform.

But there was one thing Tigo did not like…

Being in front of others.

scenes.summary: Tigo is invited to perform but feels too shy and decides not to join.
scenes.text:
One day, the jungle animals planned a big show.

“Everyone can perform!” said Mina the Monkey.

“I’ll dance!” said the peacock.

“I’ll sing!” said the parrot.

Mina turned to Tigo.

“What will you do?”

Tigo looked down.

“I… I don’t know,” he said softly.

Tigo knew he had a talent.

He could tell amazing stories.

But he was too shy.

“What if I forget?” he worried.

“What if everyone laughs?”

So he decided not to join.
scenes.image_prompt: jungle animals planning show while shy tiger looks nervous, bright cartoon style

scenes.summary: Ravi encourages Tigo and helps him practice storytelling.
scenes.text:
That evening, his friend Ravi the Rabbit came by.

“Why aren’t you performing?” Ravi asked.

“I’m too shy,” Tigo said.

Ravi smiled.

“You tell the best stories! You should try.”

Tigo wasn’t sure.

Ravi had an idea.

“Let’s practice together,” he said.

Tigo took a deep breath.

He began telling a story.

At first, his voice was soft.

But slowly, it grew stronger.

Ravi clapped.

“That was wonderful!” he said.

story:
Tigo the Tiger Who Was Too Shy

In a deep green jungle, lived a little tiger named Tigo.

Tigo had bright stripes, big eyes, and a gentle heart.

He loved to watch others play and perform.

But there was one thing Tigo did not like…

Being in front of others.

One day, the jungle animals planned a big show.

“Everyone can perform!” said Mina the Monkey.

“I’ll dance!” said the peacock.

“I’ll sing!” said the parrot.

Mina turned to Tigo.

“What will you do?”

Tigo looked down.

“I… I don’t know,” he said softly.

Tigo knew he had a talent.

He could tell amazing stories.

But he was too shy.

“What if I forget?” he worried.

“What if everyone laughs?”

So he decided not to join.

That evening, his friend Ravi the Rabbit came by.

“Why aren’t you performing?” Ravi asked.

“I’m too shy,” Tigo said.

Ravi smiled.

“You tell the best stories! You should try.”

Tigo wasn’t sure.

Ravi had an idea.

“Let’s practice together,” he said.

Tigo took a deep breath.

He began telling a story.

At first, his voice was soft.

But slowly, it grew stronger.

Ravi clapped.

“That was wonderful!” he said.

The next day, Tigo stepped onto the stage.

His heart was beating fast.

But he remembered his practice.

He took a deep breath…

And began.

Tigo told his story beautifully.

The animals listened quietly.

And then—

Clap! Clap! Clap!

Everyone cheered!

Tigo smiled.

“I did it!” he said.

Being shy is okay.

But trying can help you shine.

The End
